about: The writer statue (assets/models/writer-statue.glb), measured by tools/writers/build-statue.mjs on the full source mesh.
space: Statue space, the model's own: y up, its base on y = 0, 2 high, centred on its plinth in x and z, the front facing +z (seen by a camera on +z looking along -z). Lengths are in these units.
boxes: A box is { min, max } in statue space. An oriented box (obb) is { centre, axes, half }: three unit axes, and its half size along each; a point p is inside when |dot(p - centre, axes[i])| <= half[i] for each i.

cover.about: The book's front cover, the face with the title and the logo. corners are top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left as seen from the front; the spine is its left edge (top, bottom), where it opens; normal points out of the cover, up from its foot to its head, right from the spine to the fore-edge; size is [width, height]; thickness is the book's, behind the cover. The modelled book is a little out of true: the corners are where its edges meet, each at the cover's depth there (not quite in one plane), and the bottom-left one lies behind a fold of the robe.

nib.about: The pen's silver nib: axes[1] runs along the pen to its tip.

masks.about: The middle of the masks as seen from the front (their front-most surface), and the box of that surface.
